title: Spray booths (NFPA 33): which safety-code permits apply to the installation
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: April 2024 (platform created April 12, 2024, last updated April 12, 2024)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies the permitting requirements under the Safety Codes Act and Permit Regulation for installing spray booths, spray areas and spray rooms.
The Discussion says the AHJ would apply the SCA and the Permit Regulation to installations within the scope of NFPA 33.
The document lists HVAC, fire suppression, electrical and gas systems as examples that would require safety codes permits.
The joint interpretation applies to systems serving spaces that contain hazardous gases, dusts or liquids, such as spray booths, where specific NBC(AE) requirements are not stated.
